comments.content: I think you can just export the result from `createPlugin` because it returns a Hono app instance and you can just [default export](https://hono.dev/docs/getting-started/cloudflare-workers#_2-hello-world)
I think it should be in the env because it's something that the plugin developer should set, not the plugin user (partner).
@gentlementlegen are you running it with your own kernel or production kernel? if you are using your own then you need to set custom public key in the `createPlugin` options parameter

The Hono server automatically reads the env from Cloudflare fetch or from `process.env` if it's run in Node. 
I didn't even notice that I'm validating the env from the `process.env` instead of from Hono context.
